name: Gullash
source: A stout defender once in service to the empire, Gullash now roams the land freeing his mind from his past. He loves food and feeling the outdoors. Being the shield of the party, boasting about the hardiness of his scales, he is carefree and upbeat in battle.
translation: A stout defender once in service to the empire, Gullash now roams the land freeing his mind from his past. He loves food and feeling the outdoors. Being the shield of the party, boasting about the hardiness of his scales, he is carefree and upbeat in battle.
